tagline: Dari emotion labeling for YouTube comments
runs_empty: No batch runs yet. Start a New job (paste video/channel URLs) or run youtube_batch on the server.
about_intro: DEEP-Dari (ParsBERT A4) labels public YouTube comments into eight emotions. Unusable content is filtered before the model; low-confidence predictions abstain.
about_step_clean: Clean: strip URLs, @mentions, and emoji; unify Persian orthography.
about_step_gate: Gate: empty, too short (<4 tokens), or mostly non-Persian → Excluded (no model call).
about_step_model: Predict: eight-class emotion on usable Dari/Persian text.
about_excluded: Not classifiable (noise / wrong language). Shown in All-comments view.
about_others: Usable Dari where the model is unsure. Default Usable-only charts treat this as abstention.
about_ethics: Fear and Anger go to a human review queue. The system never takes automated action against users.
view_hint_usable: Charts and KPIs on Dari/Persian comments after filter. Others = model abstain only.
view_hint_all: Includes Excluded (emoji / non-Persian) so you can show raw stream noise.
job_videos: Videos (URLs or IDs, one per line)
job_channel_hint: @handles and /c/ /user/ URLs are resolved on the server.
no_api_key: YouTube API key not set on server
